reply.text:
That's one I won't go near. I don't give doses for SARMs or any drugs, and a stack for bulking is something to talk through with a doctor, who can speak to the real risks and what's right for you.

What I can do is the training side. If you want to put on size, I can build you a muscle-focused block, and the biggest levers there are steady progressive overload, enough protein and enough food overall, and sleep. Tell me how many days a week you can train and I'll set it up.
